metaTitle: Sample report: an AI assistant evaluation, start to finish
metaDescription: A complete example of a Caudals evaluation report about a fictitious insurer's home-policy assistant: findings with likely causes, 48 tested questions with transcripts and sources, a three-month trend and a comparison. Synthetic data.
label: Example
syntheticLine: Synthetic data about a fictitious company. It shows what a reviewed report looks like; no real expert reviewed it.
title: What a finished *evaluation* looks like
standfirst: A fictitious insurer, {company}, its home-policy assistant and 48 questions written from its policy documents. This is the report we deliver: the score, what fails and why, every answer with its source, and what to fix first.
scoreSentence: {pass} of {scored} assessed answers were fully correct.
scoreInterval: 95% interval {low} to {high}. {unscored} answers were not scored and are explained below.
trendLead: The same 48 questions, asked again every month. The fixes made after each report show up in the next run.
comparisonLead: Each question is paired with itself on the same frozen test set, so a change means the assistant's answer changed.
findingsLead: Patterns backed by the results, most severe first. Causes are hypotheses drawn from the evidence, not verified root causes.
improvementsLead: Each change names who owns it and how the next run will check it.
resultsLead: Failures first. Open a question to see the assistant's answer, the expected answer and the passage it comes from.
question: Question
ctaBody: Run the free test on your own assistant, or ask us for a pilot evaluation built from your documentation.
disclaimer: Caudals reports evidence about the answers it tested, on the questions and dates shown. This page shows the format of a report; the company and every answer in it are invented.
